title: Single- and Multilevel Quadrature with Error Control for Fourier Pricing under the Rough Heston Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.00438v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unlike the classical Heston model, Fourier pricing under the rough Heston model requires solving a fractional Riccati equation at every quadrature point. Since the required resolution varies with model parameters and quadrature point, a single uniform time discretization can be inefficient. We develop single- and multilevel Gauss-Laguerre quadrature methods that balance the time discretization and Fourier quadrature errors. Both methods scale the laguerre weight to the estimated Fourier integrand decay. The single-level method allocates a prescribed tolerance between the two errors. The multilevel method splits the integrand into a level-zero term and level differences, selecting quadrature points separately at each level. translated_abstract: 与经典的Heston模型不同，粗糙Heston模型下的傅里叶定价需要在每个求积点处求解一个分数阶Riccati方程。由于所需的分辨率随模型参数和求积点而变化，单一的均匀时间离散化可能效率低下。我们开发了单层和多层高斯-拉盖尔（Gauss-Laguerre）求积方法，以平衡时间离散化误差与傅里叶求积误差。两种方法都将拉盖尔权重缩放到所估计的傅里叶被积函数的衰减程度。单层方法在两类误差之间分配预设的容差。多层方法将被积函数拆分为零层项与各层之间的差分，并在每一层分别选择求积点。假设傅里叶被积函数的离散化误差为 $O(\Delta t^p)$，计算一次特征函数的代价为 $O(\Delta t^{-\beta})$，且代数高斯-拉盖尔求积误差为 $O(N^{\ldots}$（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了带误差控制的单层与多层高斯-拉盖尔求积方法，通过自适应平衡时间离散化误差与傅里叶求积误差，实现了粗糙Heston模型下高效且精确的傅里叶期权定价。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes single- and multilevel Gauss-Laguerre quadrature methods with error control, which adaptively balance the time discretization and Fourier quadrature errors to achieve efficient and accurate Fourier pricing under the rough Heston model.
